mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% does not produce positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the interaction term is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% over 3 months), the increased cost of capital depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25% over 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST growth > 0.8% month-over-month) indicates strong residential demand that correlates with broader economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST grows by at least 0.8% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.7% month-over-month) combined with robust housing starts (HOUST growth > 0.8% month-over-month) indicates synchronized economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and HOUST growth does not produce positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the interaction term is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month), overheating risks trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month.
